pipeline_compile_scope: validated_pipeline creation/validation after one earlier pipeline creation; may use driver cache; not cold startup compile
timing_scope: Native offscreen serialized completion wall clocks. Projection/camera + select + uniform update + production scene and 100 percent upsample + finish + submit + blocking queue completion. No readback, geometry/target allocation, pipeline creation or presentation in sample. Preallocated geometry/targets/uniform/readback; selection allocates its production vectors. Rotating mode order between repeats.
cpu_frustum_ms: select observer boundary 0 to 1; plane construction and AABB tests when enabled; all-visible flag allocation otherwise
cpu_lod_selection_ms: select observer boundary 1 to 2; distance LOD and stable draw-list construction; still constructs list when LOD disabled
cpu_encode_ms: end of select through queue uniform write, command generation, scene and upsample passes, encoder finish
native_queue_completion_wall_ms: frame entry before camera/selection through blocking completion; CPU and driver/queue work, not GPU execution time
native_frame_interval_ms: genuine current minus previous frame starts within ten consecutive measured samples; first row each block blank; no warmups or CSV formatting included
gpu_timestamp_reason: not enabled; GL software adapter evidence; blank GPU time never inferred from wall time
